mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bgxt_CriticalValue (report_id, critical_value, add_date, add_oper_code, add_oper_name, xmid) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{criticalValue}, NOW(), #{addOperCode}, #{addOperName}, #{xmid})
mapper.update: UPDATE bgxt_CriticalValue SET cancel_date=NOW(), cancel_oper_code=#{cancelOperCode} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.sql: cv.add_date >= #{beginDate} AND cv.add_date <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND cv.cancel_date IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bgxt_CriticalValue cv WHERE

SELECT COALESCE(k.ksmc, b.ksdm, '未知科室') as ksmc, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM bgxt_CriticalValue cv LEFT JOIN bgxt_brxx b ON cv.report_id=b.brxx_id LEFT JOIN sys_kssz k ON b.ksdm=k.ksdm WHERE GROUP BY b.ksdm, k.ksmc
SELECT COALESCE(jf.xmzwmc, '未知项目') as xmmc, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM bgxt_CriticalValue cv LEFT JOIN sys_jyxm_full jf ON cv.xmid = jf.xmid WHERE GROUP BY cv.xmid, jf.xmzwmc ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT COALESCE(cv.add_oper_name, '未知') as czyxm, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM bgxt_CriticalValue cv WHERE GROUP BY cv.add_oper_name ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cv.add_date, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM bgxt_CriticalValue cv WHERE GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
SELECT COALESCE(b.syqk, '未知') as syqk, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM bgxt_CriticalValue cv LEFT JOIN bgxt_brxx b ON cv.report_id = b.brxx_id WHERE GROUP BY b.syqk
